term: forward propagation of a represented member location
definition: For represented sets s,t and a region r, actual decode(t)∈decode(s) plus location of t at r implies location of s at r. This gives no converse and imposes no restriction at an empty-set representative. The populated Controls retain this forward rule while an existing empty-set representative is located and reverse support is false.
note: Analyst location/representation profile for #1109, attribution deferred. No claim that every set or every nominalist/realist theory has this profile. See docs/showcase-naturalism.md §4 and ATTEMPT-NATURALISM-SET-REPRESENTATIVES-1109.
